# @JoeOfSomeTrades

> Personal portfolio for @JoeOfSomeTrades, an enthusiast of all things IT, music,
> audio, and game design and development. The site is one arcade-themed page with
> three views and four projects.

The site is static. It holds no login and no paywall. Each view has its own hash
URL, so the page never reloads on navigation.

## Views

- [About Me](https://joeofsometrades.com/#about): A short introduction and every contact link.
- [Projects](https://joeofsometrades.com/#projects): The project index.
- [Certifications](https://joeofsometrades.com/#certs): Certifications and their dates, with a link to each official description.

## Projects

- [Maximum Slappage](https://joeofsometrades.com/#radio): A Live365 radio station I run. https://live365.com/station/Maximum-Slappage-a57727
- [Portfolio](https://joeofsometrades.com/#portfolio): This site itself, built with Astro and deployed on Cloudflare Workers with Static Assets. The source lives at https://github.com/DecibillyJoel/portfolio.
- [Smiles Sadistic Adventure](https://joeofsometrades.com/#game): A browser game. The source lives at https://github.com/DecibillyJoel/Smiles-Sadistic-Adventure.
- [Audio Productions](https://joeofsometrades.com/#audio): Music, arrangements, and voice acting, newest first. https://soundcloud.com/joeofsometrades
